ns2:section.sectionText: Online. First session is face-to-face, Thursday, January 23, 5:00-6:30, room 107 Art+Design Bldg. (408 E. Peabody Drive, Champaign). An introduction to contemporary visual culture in the United States and to major theoretical perspectives on visuality, mass communication, consumer culture, new media and digital technologies. Students will develop their capacity to interpret images from a variety of critical viewpoints.
